title: Screen time
info: Screens include phones, tablets, computers, and TVs. They are useful, and your body also needs breaks.
Look up and far away now and then, move around, and switch screens off before sleep so you can rest.

questions.q: A helpful habit during screen time is
options: staring without blinking for an hour
taking breaks to move and rest your eyes
using a screen in bed until sunrise
can make it harder to rest if you keep going
optional if the game is fun

questions.q: If your eyes feel tired, you can
options: move the screen closer and brighter with no break
